text: 62-year-old male. REQUEST TEST: Punch biopsy of both penile and digital lesions for histopathology.

Given the chronic, non-healing nature of these crusty lesions despite previous treatment and your significant smoking history, I suspect an infectious etiology common in endemic regions, such as Donovanosis (Granuloma Inguinale), but the biopsy will be definitive.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Vital Signs: Temperature 36.8°C (98.2°F), Blood Pressure 130/85 mmHg, Heart Rate 82 bpm, Respiratory Rate 14 breaths/min. speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy findings of nuclear hyperchromasia, multinucleation, and increased mitotic figures are highly concerning for Squamous Cell Carcinoma, particularly given the lesion's non-healing nature and your smoking history.
